title: Assess Markets
body:
The Assess Markets tool helps in generating reports containing network overlaps and competitive dashboard details to analyze the data comprehensively.



Accessing Assess Market

To navigate to this module, click on Broker Tools on the left sidebar navigation menu. Then select Assess Markets.



Report Criteria Section

Most fields within the Report Criteria work as autosuggest lists. As you begin typing content into a field, the list will be populated with matching options. Your search criteria will determine which providers will be included in the network comparisons.

 



1.	Geography Field

Select a Geography from the dropdown. You can type the first few characters to narrow down the search. Only one selection for city, county, MSA, or state is allowed.

\    Note: Zip codes, population files, radius search, and bulk zip codes are not available to choose as in other modules.

 



2.	Base Network

Select a Base Network from the dropdown. Only one network can be selected. 

 



3.	Comparison Networks

\    Select Comparison Networks from the dropdown. Multiple selections are allowed. All project networks are available, even if no providers exist in the selected geography. The selected Base network is excluded from this list. Selected networks are displayed with a removable “x”. You can click on the “x” to remove the added Comparison Network. In the dropdown list, the selected networks are bold. 

\    

4.	Include Market Leaders

This is a checkbox option. By default, it is checked. When checked, Market Leader pages will be included in the generated report.

 

Report Cover Options Section

Prepared For and Prepared By fields: These fields are free text input fields, and you can enter a maximum of 30 characters. This entered information appears on the report cover.

•	Prepared For: Enter the name of the intended audience for this report.    

•	Prepared By: Enter the name of person who prepared the report.



 

Report Generation

The Request Report button activates when a Geography, Base Network, and at least one Comparison Network are selected. Click the Request Report button to generate Comparison Report. 

•	The exported report is generated based on the selected criteria.

•	The numbers in the report represent Provider counts (numbers of providers).

 

 

 

Click on the Download results link to download the .pdf report. The report will also be sent to the email of the logged in user.

Report Cover Page

The Report Cover contains information from Prepared For and Prepared By fields in Report Cover Options section (outlined in red in the screenshot below) and also includes the Project name.

 

Analysis Criteria Page

The options selected on the Report Criteria screen will be listed on the Analysis Criteria page.

 

Overlap Summary Page

Overlap Summary displays the Compare Networks Overlap report graphs. The graphs are similar to the design in Compare Networks using provider counts.

•	When only one comparison network is selected, the results are displayed as a Venn diagram. 



\    



i.	When there are zero results for both networks, the Venn diagram will show two non-intersecting circles.

ii.	When one network has > 0 results and the other has 0 results, the Venn diagram is shown as a circle for the network with results and a dot for the network with 0 results. 

\    For example, in the above image, the bottom left graph compares the number of providers that have a provider type of Primary Care and have a specialty of Standard Medical for base network and comparison network. Out of 2352 providers in Healthy Start PPO only 1508 are unique to Healthy Start PP and 844 providers are in common with Acme Health HMO. Similarly, the bottom right graph compares the number of providers in those networks that have a provider type of Specialist. Examples of specialties are Gastroenterology, Orthodontics, Periodontics, etc.

Note: The number of graphs displayed depends on the specialty mapping and the project chosen.



•	When there is more than one comparison network selected, the results are displayed as a bar graph for each provider type in a separate page. The title of the pages follows “Overlap With Each Network - Provider type” format.

\    Note: Provider types depend on the Project and Specialty Mapping selected.

 



When there are multiple comparison networks, the Overlap graph for the combined comparison networks is not included.



Market Leader Pages

These pages are included only when the Market Leaders option is selected on the Report Criteria page. 

•	The titles of the pages follow this format: "Provider type Market Leaders"

Note: Provider types depend on the Project and Specialty Mapping selected.

•	The Market Leader pages display the Competitive Dashboard Project Summary details for the selected criteria by provider counts.

•	These pages include networks that are in geography, even when the network was not selected as part of the analysis criteria.

\    Each bar graph displays networks with at least 10% market penetration in the selected geography, ranked by network size within that region.

\    For more information on market penetration, refer to Market Penetration in the Glossary.
shortDescription: The Assess Markets tool helps in generating reports containing network overlaps and competitive dashboard details to analyze the data comprehensively.
